name: mirage
text: Yes, one more $5 Starter key is worth it. Engine usage figures now: your two Starter keys have about 7,000 and 7,400 of 20,000 credits left (about 14,400 together), and they reset Nov 1. The key the engine has been rotating through spent about 11,000 credits in the last 5-6 days (roughly 2,000 a day across the keys), which would use up the remaining 14,400 around Oct 27, a few days before the reset. The free keys are mostly spent (1 to 54 credits left). A new Starter key adds 20,000, enough to cover the gap, and the engine picks up new keys from the PARLAY_API_KEY secret by itself (send it from the app's Settings > Cloud scan > Send my API keys). Rough estimate from usage so far: if you would rather not, the engine's governor rests ParlayAPI when it runs low and the other feeds carry on, so the cost of not buying is fresher odds fewer hours a day, not a stopped engine.
